results.content: WASHINGTON, D.C. (September 9, 2026) – Cygnal released findings from its September National Voter Trends poll of 1,500 likely 2026 general-election voters (conducted September 1–2). The survey finds socialism has become an acceptable political identity for a meaningful share of the electorate, especially younger voters and renters, even as most voters who embrace the label cannot correctly define it.
